content_data.meeting_title: Performance Optimization Architecture Review - Patient Data Processing Pipeline
agenda_items: Evaluate caching layer implementation for FHIR API endpoints
Discuss database indexing strategy for patient record queries
Review current latency metrics for healthcare data ingestion across EU regions
key_decisions: Implement Redis cluster with data residency controls for each EU region to comply with healthcare regulations
Allocate dedicated performance testing environment with production-like data volumes within 3 weeks
Adopt asynchronous event-driven architecture for non-critical patient data synchronization
technical_blockers: Legacy SOAP-based integration with third-party lab systems creating bottleneck in results processing pipeline
Insufficient observability into cross-service transaction traces for diagnosing performance degradation
Data anonymization processes consuming excessive CPU resources during ETL operations
